_doc: §14.1 HUMAN GATE artifact. The human author inspects a failed real-agent
trace, identifies the decision that they believe causally drove the
failure, and adds an entry to `labels` with the trace's run_id, the
fixture_id, the decision_id of the root cause, and a one-line note.
The acceptance test in tests/acceptance/test_top1_attribution.py loads
this file, fits the outcome model on the runs_v2 corpus, and asserts
that for at least one label, attribute_failure(...).top_k(1)[0].decision_id
equals root_cause_decision_id. Test SKIPS gracefully when labels is
empty (the gate is open but unanswered).
Run files are read from bench/real/runs_v2/<run_id>.json. The autonomous
loop MUST NOT auto-fill this file — labeling is the human's epistemic
